title: McpServerConfig

ceiling.description:
The most an agent may do on this device, per environment name or `*`.
An environment without an entry is limited only by the project.

principal.description: The name audit records attribute agent requests to.

$comment: Generated from McpServerConfig; run ./scripts/generate-artifacts.sh. Do not edit.

AccessLevel.description: Access levels a repo grants per environment. Each includes the previous.

oneOf.description: `view` plus restart and job run, cancel, and retry.
`operate` plus deploy, rollback, and team sync.

`deploy` plus exec, forward, setting secrets and variables,
emergency blocks, and audit.

AgentAccess.description: What an agent may do in one environment.

exec.description: Services the agent may run commands in: `true`, or a list of names.

secrets.description:
The agent may set secrets and variables on the environment's hosts
for the next deployment, when its user may. With level `deploy` on an
environment that runs on this machine, it may also create the local
secret store, generate missing secrets, and install a managed secret
provider. It never reads a value.

AgentAccessConfig.description: `production: view` or `local: { level: deploy, exec: true }`.

ServiceSelection.description: Services an add-on applies to: all of them, none, or a named list.
